outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Cell death (%) shown as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments (per caption), with error bars but no individual data points overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is a bar chart of Cell death (%) with visible error bars indicating averaged/replicate data, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart of Cell death (%) at multiple time points, reported as mean±s.d. of three experiments, but individual data points are not shown.
Panel D is a bar chart of Cell death (%) with error bars shown, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
